status: staging implementation and harmless-fixture verification complete; native integration remains parent-owned

api.constructor: DurationSession(worker_sha256=REVIEWED_WORKER_SHA, source_manifest_sha256=REVIEWED_MANIFEST_SHA, worker=ABSOLUTE_WORKER, python=TRUSTED_INTERPRETER, assets=ABSOLUTE_ASSETS, model_manifest=ABSOLUTE_MODEL_MANIFEST, profile_id=FIXED_ENUM, coordinator=TRUSTED_ADMISSION)
api.usage: async with session: prediction = await session.predict(normalized_text)

result.tokens: exact single-item core preprocessed input width, including language framing

api.semantic_limit: Predictions only, not generated speech, PCM duration, audible quality, or proof of continuity. No character/WPM duration estimate.
api.profiles: conditioning_b plus conditioning_b_{calm,active}_{low,medium,high}; fixed for the session; no vectors, paths, speed, or arbitrary prefixes in request JSON
api.selection_policy: Parent planner must admit only candidates with prediction.seconds <= 28 and tokens <= 512, preserving full lexical coverage. Worker rejects preprocessed token widths outside 1..512 before invoking DP, terminating that failed session; keep candidates bounded or open a new reviewed session after rejection. Predictions above 28 are deliberately returned so planner can split; unchanged actual synthesis worker still enforces 30-second PCM cap.
api.task_ownership: Single-use context, zero queued concurrent predict calls, shared lease acquired before verification/spawn, fresh child process group, cancellation-shielded terminal cleanup. Repeated cancellation cannot release lease while spawn is unresolved or child/pipes/tasks remain live. Unexpected cleanup failures retain lease fail-closed.
api.diagnostics: Only allowlisted failure_reason and signed returncode retained. Raw native stdout/stderr and text are not logged or included in parser error messages.

worker_protocol.cli: python -I ABSOLUTE_DURATION_WORKER serve ABSOLUTE_ASSETS ABSOLUTE_MODEL_MANIFEST FIXED_PROFILE EXPECTED_SOURCE_MANIFEST_SHA256

request.text: nonempty validated text, <=800 characters and <=3200 UTF-8 bytes

worker_protocol.framing: One strict UTF-8 JSON object plus newline per frame. Exact object fields; duplicate keys, nonfinite values, malformed IDs, unsupported tags, oversized/unterminated lines fail closed. Worker exits after result 64; parent handles that result/EOF race.
worker_protocol.runtime: Source verification before guard/SDK import; fixed offline environment and native syscall isolation before runtime/model allocation; unchanged full asset/profile validation and native memory-headroom/RSS monitor. Only duration_predictor.onnx is opened as an ONNX session. UnicodeProcessor([text], 'id'), selected immutable style_dp, and array division by speed 1.05 match the native core path. No guard.Runtime, TTS, text encoder, denoiser/vector estimator, vocoder, or PCM synthesis.

relocated_manifest_integration_contract: Both parent DurationSession and worker resolve upstream-manifest.json beside the selected duration_worker.py. Worker also resolves the fixed-hash source_pins.py beside itself. There is no source-manifest CLI path or environment override.
The current unchanged manifest still names sdk_root=/root/supertonic-live-fix/supertonic. It does not automatically select /root/sela-live/vendor/supertonic.

For canonical/installed roots, parent must explicitly create/review a relocated manifest with sdk_root, guard_root, and live_root pointing to the intended absolute symlink-free trees, preserving the reviewed per-file hashes/inventory. Copy any guard-relative voice_assets required by selected_profile_path unchanged and keep their pinned manifests valid. This subtask did not edit upstream-manifest.json or source pins.

Hash the final relocated manifest bytes and independently review that exact digest; pass it explicitly as source_manifest_sha256. Do not replace the expectation with a hash learned from unreviewed installed bytes. The worker accepts this explicit reviewed digest instead of hardcoding the staging manifest hash.

Bind the exact final duration_worker.py source SHA256 separately in worker_sha256. DurationSession checks the worker digest and all source pins on every spawn; the isolated child repeats helper/manifest/source verification before guard/SDK imports. Worker relocation alone does not require source rewriting.

The interpreter intentionally allows trusted venv symlinks, matching the legacy bridge. Worker/assets/model-manifest/source-pin paths do not allow symlinks in any component. Raw request data never chooses any of these paths.

Evaluation defaults to AdmissionCoordinator and respects production priority. Production integration must first own/quiesce Speech/ASR resources and inject ProductionAdmissionCoordinator using the existing shared persistent inode. Never instantiate a second independent production workload slot.

verification.method: Vertical RED/GREEN slices with actual harmless Python children and injected tensor/session/guard fixtures. No actual ONNX graph allocation, native inference, speech synthesis, downloads, service operations, git changes, or production edits.

issues_encountered_and_resolved: Interrupted session inherited credentials/proxies: replaced with a fixed allowlist in parent and child.
Generic protected-path check rejected usual venv interpreter symlinks: allowed only at trusted interpreter seam.
Failed stdout readers left paused pipe transports open despite child exit: kill owned group, cancel/join readers, bounded discard-to-EOF, then await reaping before lease release.
Result 64 could race worker EOF: terminal budget EOF explicitly handled after its framed result.
SDK-capable test interpreter did not have numpy installed: no installation attempted; model behavior seam is exercised with harmless injected tensor fixtures instead.
remaining_parent_checks: Review final exact sources and relocated manifest digest; wire planner/session/native rendering seam without changing production.

Under the intended app-owned native interpreter and real service sandbox, verify native syscall denial, resource/headroom behavior, all seven profile paths and DP-only session RSS/startup; none of those native runs was authorized for this subtask.
Compare actual DP text_ids/text_mask/style_dp and predictions against the unchanged full native core at speed 1.05 for representative text, Unicode/punctuation/tags and policy-boundary candidates.

Verify actual SDK synthesis partitioning does not change the planned single-utterance preprocessing; ensure <=28-second prediction margin and <=512 tokens for every admitted segment, preserving full source coverage and unchanged 30-second actual PCM cap.
Measure actual generated PCM duration, browser ACK/delivery/continuity and listener quality separately. Harmless fixtures and model predictions are not speech acceptance.
